item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The Administration states that it will continue negotiations with private insurers to reach a voluntary compromise; this is discretionary implementation activity and does not itself change legal rights or require a specified later legal outcome.","evidence":"we will continue to pursue an agreeable compromise with these companies"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs Secretary Mathews to seek manufacturers’ voluntary cooperation while negotiations continue; the action is executive coordination and advocacy, with no dictated or self-executing legal consequence.","evidence":"I have directed Secretary Mathews to ask for the cooperation of the manufacturers again"}]}
